title: WALDWERK Mortar and Pestle - Mortar and Pestle Set with Anti-Scratch Oak Wood Base - Mortar with Extra Large Pestle Made of Natural Granite - Large Mortar and Pestle - Ideal for Guacamole
description:
About this item
🌿 BEAUTIFUL DESIGN - the high-quality oak wood base protects your kitchen shelf from scratches while using your mortar. Moreover, the noble oak wood combines with the natural granite to give a jewelry look in your kitchen!

reviews_1s:
I don't understand why this product has such good reviews. The grinding surface is rough and porous while only the outside is polished and smooth. When in use, the grinding generates a fine granite dust which mixes with the material in the bowl. No thank you. I prefer my herbs without stone dust from an unknown quarry. It's a very pretty product to be sure but I'll be shopping for something ceramicThe Waldwerk Mortar and Pestle ordered is beautiful and heavy. I will keep. BUT The ad misleads Amazon customers. It is NOT extra large. It does not even hold two cups of anything. I paid $49.90 for this set and feels like way to much money. Additionally, instructions say to dry washed mortar in a drying rack before placing it on the wood base. I am writing this review to help some other Amazon customer from making a poor purchase choice. The review may not even get posted.The mortar and pestle are really nice; but the reason i gave a 1 rating is that I bought it January 12 and return is February 13. I bought it as a gift, didn’t open the package and presented the gift today, March 4. I had to hold it because of the birthday date. When opened, the pestle was broken on the end and the Manufacturer GLUED the broken piece back on. Unacceptable! And the 30-day return is past. What can I do? I would like to have the pestle replaced. Thank you
Everyone, if you buy a gift ahead of being able to present it, open it and inspect it BEFORE return policy passed.The purchase was an expensive one and the pestle is missing 🤬I don't know whether their version of extra large is different than mine but this is NOT extra large. I'm not sure it will even hold one avocado. I will be returning.Seems like a case of form over factor. The bowl of the pestle has grooves in it that immediately captures anything that you were grinding. This makes it very difficult to clean, and if you were working with anything precise from an input standpoint, the yield from your grinding will be much less.Title speaks for itself. Used only a handful of times and the pestle broke. Absolute garbage quality.
